author: Andreas Spiess
description:
Too often, AI coding is still open-loop: prompt, code, hope. You do the flashing, find the bugs, and explain what went wrong. Again and again.
What if the AI could do that part, too?
In this video, I’ll show you that it is possible and how to do it. It lets an AI agent develop complete ESP32 applications from a specification. The AI writes the firmware, builds it, flashes it to real hardware, runs tests, observes the results, fixes failures, and repeats until the tests pass. With mind-boggling speed!
And you don’t need a professional lab. You can build this for your hobby projects.

My second channel: https://www.youtube.com/HB9BLAWireless
